messages:
Maya: Found a mystery container in the back of the fridge labeled only 'eat?'. Anyone own it? :eyes:
Owen: Not me. looks like chili? Smells fine but better to ask.
Priya: If unlabeled and older than 48h let's compost it. We had a fridge policy doc somewhere.
Sasha: I put a sticky on it 'CLAIM BY 4PM or COMPOST' and moved it to the top shelf. Also FYI the tea box is empty ":tea:" - can someone grab a box of chamomile?
Maya: I'll pick tea on my walk. Also quick poll: for Friday snack run do we want pastries or fruit? React :one: pastries :two: fruit
Owen: :two: fruit keeps us sane
Priya: :one: pastries once in a while :)
KitchenBot: Reminder: Fridge tidy scheduled Friday 11:00. Unlabeled >72h will be removed. Please label with "Name | Date".
Sasha: Can we get a small roll of labeling stickers? I volunteer to print a sheet.
Maya: Thanks Sasha. Also can we sticky a one-line microwave rule: 'Cover food. 30s wipe if spills.' Short and sweet.
Owen: Agree. I'll put up a laminated note tomorrow.
Priya: Tea: Maya, thanks! If you can get chamomile and green that'd be great.
Maya: On it. Anything else?
Sasha: Coffee beans low too. If anyone's going to the cafe, dark roast please. I'll leave $5 in the coffee fund jar.
Maya: Noted. Claim container still unclaimed at 3:45pm. If no one claims it before 4pm I'll compost.
Owen: Thanks for handling this, Maya.
Maya: Compost done at 4:02pm. All tidy. :seedling:
